answer_1.quote: We evaluate our unstructured pruning framework on Mamba models across diverse tasks, including language modeling, long-range understanding, and time-series forecasting, using benchmark datasets such as WikiText-103, Long Range Arena, and ETT.
answer_1.outputs: sequence predictions for language modeling, long-range arena tasks, and time-series forecasting

answer_2.quote: Experiments on WikiText-103, Long Range Arena, and ETT demonstrate up to 70% parameter reduction with only 3-9% performance degradation... At 50% sparsity, our approach increases MSE by only 2.4% on average (0.343 vs. 0.335)...
